purpose: Assemble the mature Potato House vertical cosmology into one inhabitable reader field without collapsing typed operators or claiming biblical/project identity.

geometry_boundary.father_center: C_F=(0,+r/2): upper field center and upper tip of shared Door
geometry_boundary.crown: H_top=(0,+3r/2): outer Heaven-facing pole / crown, not identical with Father-center
geometry_boundary.world_midpoint: O=(0,0): Plane × Axis relational midpoint inside the Door
geometry_boundary.son_center: C_S=(0,-r/2): lower field center / lower Door tip / Seed Junction
geometry_boundary.lower_pole: E_bottom=(0,-3r/2): lower outer boundary; deep root/Drain symbolism can extend toward it

levels.label: Crown · Mountain summit · North of North
inhabitants: messenger/angel traditions where source traditions support them
levels.project_function: maximum orientation and integrative perspective; outer crown beyond the Father-center
biblical_neighbors: Isaiah 2:2-4 / Micah 4:1-4 — mountain of the LORD's house
levels.boundary: Height is not automatic holiness; Matthew 4:8-10 supplies a counter-image in which height can become temptation to domination.

levels.label: Father-center · Throne · House · Garden
levels.project_function: source-facing center that orients, contains, cultivates and distributes rather than merely ruling from altitude
project_anchors: 2026-05-18: 'pass through the needles eye. through heavens gate, You are in the garden'
biblical_neighbors: Genesis 2:8-15 — planted Garden, river flowing out, human placed to work/serve and keep/guard
Isaiah 6 — throne vision in temple setting
Revelation 22:1-5 — river, Tree of Life, divine presence
levels.boundary: Genesis Eden, Johannine Father's House and project Garden/House are comparators, not one historical architecture.

levels.label: Heaven's Gate · Needle · upper Door threshold
inhabitants: guardians/pillars where a source supports them
levels.project_function: constriction before entry to integrated Garden/House; entry changes context rather than merely changing altitude
biblical_neighbors: Genesis 28:12-19 — earth/heaven stairway, House of God, Gate of Heaven
levels.boundary: 'Heaven's Gate into the Garden' is project syntax; Genesis 28 names Bethel as house/gate but does not place Jacob in Eden.

levels.label: Door · Ladder · Axis · Mandorla
levels.project_function: connective architecture between source-facing and manifestation-facing fields
biblical_neighbors: John 1:51 — ascent/descent associated with Son of Man
levels.boundary: Ladder, Axis, Door, Tree and Spine are projections of related structure, not interchangeable literal objects.

levels.label: Earth · World Plane · trunk · culture
levels.project_function: where upper claims become observable consequences and where knowledge forks toward Life, Strife or repair
biblical_neighbors: Genesis 1:1-2:3 — ordered created world before the Eden narrative
Genesis 2-3 — embodied work, choice, knowledge, exile and guarded access
levels.boundary: Earth/World is not identical with fall, evil or Swamp.

levels.label: Tree fork · Knowledge → Life / Strife
levels.project_function: knowledge is upstream of both generative responsibility and unresolved reproduction
biblical_neighbors: Genesis 2-3 — Tree of Life and Tree of Knowledge are distinct biblical trees
levels.boundary: Tree of Strife is a project analytical metaphor, not a biblical tree.

levels.label: Roots · Ash · Soil · Seed
levels.project_function: past/support/residue is metabolized here; descent may become rooting, dormancy, decay, Strife or repair
levels.boundary: Root is not Strife; Ash is not permanent Strife; burial is not automatic resurrection.

levels.label: Forge · pressure / transformation
levels.project_function: pressure can convert residue into clarified tool/soil/capacity or weaponize resentment into more Strife
levels.boundary: Forge is a process that can operate in Below or World; it is not a permanent floor and is not automatically constructive.

levels.label: Swamp · Wide Road · Drain
levels.project_function: Tree of Strife feeds outward/widening recurrence into Swamp while Drain names the narrowing loss-of-agency attractor inside it
levels.boundary: Swamp is not literal wetland, all subculture, all Below or a class of people; Drain is a route/attractor, not the whole lower field.

biblical_source_notes.note: Garden, river flowing out, tree/growth environment, human work/guarding function.
Guarded access to Tree of Life after exile; useful for access/gate comparison without calling Tree of Strife biblical.
Earth-to-heaven stairway/ladder, angels, House of God and Gate of Heaven in one scene.
Mountain of the LORD's house, upward movement, teaching/judgment, swords transformed into cultivation tools.
Throne vision in temple setting; source for throne/holy-space comparison.
Father's House and dwelling places; later Christian text, not Genesis architecture.
City/gates/river/Tree of Life/restored presence; useful end-state neighbor to Garden/House repair.

boundary_regimes.House: protects differentiated rooms, circulation and legitimate Doors; boundary serves life and passage
boundary_regimes.Shell: captures sparks/value/attention, raises exit cost and makes continued enclosure more important than reintegration
boundary_regimes.qliphothic_comparator: Kabbalistic qelipot/qliphoth supplies a historical shell/husk comparator. Potatoverse uses it structurally; it is not a license to call modern people literal demons or qliphoth.
boundary_regimes.test: Does the boundary preserve differentiation and viable passage, or does life/value become fuel for preserving the enclosure?
